description_en: Queries mass messaging records under a version. This operation only queries message records that are sent by device model
description_zh: 查询版本下的群发消息记录，只针对按照机型群发的消息记录的查询
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc find-version-message-send-records --version-type FOTA --project-id P0VFCREU --page-index 1 --page-size 20 --message-type SYSTEM_UPDATE --version-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: FindVersionMessageSendRecords

parameters.help_en:
The version type. Valid values:

FOTA: system version.
APP: application version
parameters.help_zh: 版本类型，取值有： FOTA 系统版本， APP 应用版本
parameters.name: version_type

parameters.help_en: The start index of the current page
parameters.name: page_index

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The message type. Valid values:

SYSTEM_UPDATE: push notification for a system version release.
APP_VERSION_UPDATE: push notification for an application self-upgrade release
parameters.help_zh:
消息类型，取值：

SYSTEM_UPDATE：系统版本发布消息推送,
APP_VERSION_UPDATE：应用自升级发布消息推送
parameters.name: message_type
